rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for forgiving a person.

example.english: I really pardon you this time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 jyun4 loeng6 nei5 gam1 ci3

rows.note: Use this when forgiving means letting someone off or choosing not to pursue the matter.

example.english: I’ll pardon you this time, but don’t do it again.
example.traditional: 今次我放過你，下次唔好再犯。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 fong3 gwo3 nei5 haa6 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6

rows.note: Use this formal noun for forgiveness for an offence; it is the all-purpose choice for this sense.

example.english: He knelt and asked the victim for pardon.
example.traditional: 佢跪低向受害人請求寬恕。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gwai6 dai1 hoeng3 sau6 hoi6 jan4 cing2 kau4 fun1 syu3

rows.note: Use this for an official pardon that releases a convicted person from further punishment or its consequences.

example.english: The president announced a pardon for those prisoners.
example.traditional: 總統宣布赦免嗰批囚犯。
example.jyutping: zung2 tung2 syun1 bou3 se3 min5 go2 pai1 cau4 faan6

rows.note: Use this for officially pardoning someone for a crime, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The government announced that it would pardon those prisoners.
example.traditional: 政府宣布赦免嗰批囚犯。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 se3 min5 go2 pai1 cau4 faan6
